batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b CR Woakes

batting.name: MM Ali
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b R Ashwin

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b TK Curran

batting.name: PP Shaw
batting.dismissal: c MM Ali b DJ Bravo

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c SM Curran b SN Thakur

balls.text: knocks him over! Woakes has delivered under pressure. CSK finish with 188. And that has a lot to do with the Curran on Curran action not so long ago. Sam tries to reprise those big hitting heroics against a slightly more experienced death bowler in Woakes and the full and straight ball has a little too much heat
yorker outside off, he drills it to extra cover
another slower short ball, which he pulls to long-on. That's the fifty partnership in 26 balls
slower short ball outside off, he clears his front leg and thumps it to the left of extra cover
finds the yorker on leg stump, cramping Curran, who looks for another whip, but it only ricochets onto his pads and over to point
how is he doing this?! Sammy C is 33 off 13 now, and well, this is a little bit of a gift. Length ball on leg stump and it sits up for the batsman to whip  it to the square leg boundary
yorker on leg stump, he works it towards cover

360 degree genius!. The last ball was short. So he knows this one will be full. He's waiting for it. It comes down outside off. And he lashes it over cover. Everyone there is up inside the circle. And it's an easy boundary. Sammy C in full, dangerous, glorious flow
What a shot! What a freakin shot! This is a bouncer. This is rearing up over his chest. It's only crime is being outside off as Sam clears his front leg away and pounds it over midwicket

he's got effortless power, this kid. He looks tiny out on the cricket ground. A slight little thing. But as soon as the ball is in his arc - this one a full toss on leg stump - he summons the strength of Goliath! Whack over long-on
slides the slower ball a little too wide outside off

wide yorker outside off, which he inside edges. Tom races across to grab the ball, which is where short leg might have been, and immediately turns around to try and run his kid brother out. In the end, he only ends up giving an overthrow
there's the boundary CSK needed to alter the momentum! Jadeja charges out. Curran pulls his length back. Jadeja doesn't care. He loads up a pull shot and places it to the right of deep midwicket

backs away and cuts a short ball outside off to the sweeper. Avesh Khan finishes a potentially coming of age spell. 2 for 23 off his four overs. Much more disciplined than previous seasons, and didn't seem all that carried away by his own pace, like he used to be
full toss outside off, whacks it to long-off
back of a length and cramping him on middle and off stump, Jadeja defends and sprints through
yorker outside off, he squeezes it out to extra cover.
slower bouncer - the offcutter which grips in the pitch and turns past the swinging Curran. His pull shot is no use this time
looks for the yorker, doesn't quite find it, Jadeja works it to deep midwicket
he's got one back! Tom's bowled a magical over. But he ends it with one down leg side and his little brother calmly dispatches him to the fine leg boundary. Sweet timing. Sweet sweet timing.
bouncer, that he ducks under. Another dot ball.
opens the face to the slightly slower ball on and around off stump and guides it to point. This is a splendid over from Curran
slower short ball outside off, Curran gets up on his toes and blunts it
pulls a shortish delivery outside off towards square leg
smears a fuller ball outside off to long-off
slower ball outside off, forced down to long-on
full on the pads, whipped away behind square. CSK settle for just a single this time
hip-high short ball on leg stump, put away to the right of long leg. Curran sat back, waiting for the short ball, and pulled it away with authority
Dhoni bags a duck on return. Avesh pounds it on a hard length and outside off. Dhoni swings at a pull first ball and can only drag it back onto the stumps
back of a length and skidding into off, jammed back to the bowler

short on the hips, clipped away through square leg. There's a mix-up between the wickets and Raina has to go. Plus, Jadeja colliding with Avesh didn't help CSK. Jadeja turns around for the double, runs into the bowler. Around this point, Raina is almost halfway down the pitch. The throw from the deep is to Pant and he takes the bails off to see the back of Raina
here comes Jadeja: he advances down the track and swats a short ball away to deep midwicket
short slower cutter on middle, 116ks, Raina seems to be backing away to every ball now. Hoicked to long-on
pitches outside leg and skids through to strike the pad. Jadeja and Raina cross over for a leg bye
back-to-back fours to begin for the returning Jadeja. No signs of rust at all. Rides the bounce of this shorter ball outside off, opens the face of the bat and guides it fine of short third man
first-ball four for Jadeja! Dug in short and outside off, Stoinis does not have the pace to bother Jadeja. Pulled away in the gap at midwicket
Raina slinks outside leg again, full and outside off, this offcutter is slashed down to long-off
darted short and wide outside off, Raina backs away and scythes it to sweeper cover

100.2ks slower ball outside off, back-of-the-hand stuff from Curran. Rayudu aims to pump it down the ground, but didn't read this change-up. The bottom hand is yanked off the bat as he slices a loft to Dhawan at long-off

slower short ball outside off, Rayudu reads the change-up. Delays the pull and swats it away to the right of deep midwicket. Avesh tries to stop the ball with his boot, ends up escorting it to the fence
dug in short on middle, Raina backs away outside leg and carves it to sweeper
Rayudu meets another cutter, this is flapped to the leg side
back-of-the-hand slower variation, cuts away outside off, as Rayudu wafts and misses

Welcome back, Chinna Thala! Lifter aimed at the shoulder, Raina makes swinging room once again, nails a pull over square leg for six. Bam. What a way to bring up a fifty. He raises his bat and soaks in the applause from the dug out
back of a length and outside off, possibly an offcutter that sticks in the pitch. Raina aims leg side and  nearly plops it back to the bowler
length ball on middle, Rayudu leaves his crease and hauls it away to deep midwicket
much fuller and slanting in at off, jabbed back to the bowler
offcutter from Stoinis, Rayudu swings for the hills, does so early, the ball brushes the shoulder and rolls away past Pant
high full-toss over the waist. Rayudu sits back and hoists it over square leg, clearing the shorter boundary. Beamer
Raina backs away, advances down the track, and punches towards the off-side sweeper
fired on middle, Raina shows the full face of the bat once again and cracks it to long-off
Rayudu dashes out of the crease, Mishra goes shorter and wider with his legbreak. Smeared away to wide long-off
tossed on middle, Raina shows the full face of the bat and taps it back
looped up on the leg stump, Raina sizes it up and launches it into the second tier beyond square leg with a full-blooded slog-sweep
hoicked away to deep square leg
on a length and veers away outside off, Raina makes some swinging room, dashes out of the crease again and pumps the googly towards the sightscreen
Raina dashes out of the crease, yorks himself, stabbing it out to long-on. Ashwin finishes with 4-0-46-1
shorter and outside off, faster as well, Rayudu leans back and dabs it just wide of Mishra at short third man
Ashwin slows it up outside off, finds a bit of spin, Rayudu swings and inside-edges onto his pad
hip-high short ball outside off, Raina hauls it away to deep midwicket
looks like a carrom ball, the variation keeps Rayudu to a dinked single to cover
Rayudu now brings out the slog-sweep, pumping Ashwin over square leg. Fullish and outside off, muscled away to ramp up the pressure on Ashwin

tossed up on the leg stump, Raina looks in decent touch despite the lack of game time. Drops down to one knee and slog-sweeps it to the right of deep square leg. Shaw lunges to his right and swats the ball into play before tumbling beyond the boundary. Rahane tidies up
Mishra hits that in-between length, on the hips, glanced to short fine leg
down the track and stabbed down to long-on of the inner half
wide of the crease, dangled up around off at 79ks and breaking away. Rayudu is drawn into a push to cover
back of a length on middle, Raina goes on the back foot and forces it down to long-off
pushed through on middle, worked away through midwicket
thigh-high short ball on off, no turn, Raina winds up and clobbers it over midwicket. Struck flat and hard for six
speared into off stump on a length, hoicked away weakly to midwicket
arm ball from Ashwin, an inside edge saves Raina

Moeen aims for the 'V' behind the wicket now, but ends up holing out to Dhawan. He pre-meditates a reverse-swat, Ashwin pulls his length back and slides it into leg stump. Moeen can only splice it into the night sky. Dhawan runs back and then around from short third man before coolly settling under it
Moeen Ali is a spin-hitter and he's nailing his role. Ashwin darts it on middle, Moeen meets it early by stepping out and smoking it over Ashwin's head once again
Moeen charges out to Ashwin again, the spinner holds this back. Full on middle, he gets closer to the pitch and launches it over his head for six
wrong'un, short and wide, Moeen is ready for it. He sits back and chops it to sweeper cover
darted on a back of a length on middle and leg, tight defensive bowling. Forced down to long-on off the back foot
dragged down outside off, lashed away to sweeper cover for one
make it three googlies in a row. Another one that zips past the outside edge
another wrong'un, slower, fuller, floats away outside off. Moeen goes for a slog-sweep and misses it altogether
wrong'un it is. But it shorter and finishes wider, allows Moeen to jump back and crack it to sweeper
on a length and breaks away outside off past the outside edge. Raina aims to dab it down to deep third man. No dice
pause-and-deliver from Ashwin. Kedar Jadhav-esque release. Loopier and outside off, drilled through the covers
round-arm variation from Ashwin, 94ks, jammed out to the leg side
93ks dart, on a length and outside off, Moeen throws his bat at ball, slicing an outside edge fine of short third man for back-to-back fours
smoked straight of Curran at long-on. Moeen ventures down the track, extends his arms, and clubs it away to the right of long-on
sliding into the pads, worked away towards long leg
back of a length and outside off, Moeen aims leg-side, ends up chipping a leading edge to point
much fuller and outside off, knocked down to long-on
Raina slinks outside leg once again, meets a short ball outside off and utterly batters it on the bounce to Rahane at backward point
More intent from Raina, steps away outside leg. This looks like a slower delivery from Curran. Raina delays the slash and guides it to backward point
on a length and outside off, driven on the up to the left of the off-side sweeper
tip and run to the covers. Raina takes on Stoinis' arm and is quick off the blocks, good response from Moeen too
speared outside off at 94ks, non-turner, tapped away to cover
round-arm dart on the hips, deflected away behind square
Raina dashes out of the crease, takes a length ball from middle and hacks it over midwicket. Not middled, but refreshing intent from CSK
Raina's go-to shot: the inside-out chip. He backs away outside leg, collapses his back knee and scoops it up in the air, but away from the reach of extra-cover
the new ball slides on just a shade outside off, takes the inside edge and rolls to the leg side
darted on middle from round the stumps, Moeen push-drives it down to long-off
Moeen rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and glides a single down to deep third man
chest-high short ball, targeting Moeen's body, he has struggled against it in the past. This time he swivels on the back foot and hooks it away behind square

shot, Moeen! You might have seen him do this for Worcestershire Rapids at the top order. Back of a length and outside off, Moeen stands up tall and punches it beautifully between cover-point and extra-cover
pitches outside leg and skids through rapidly to tuck Moeen up and thump his thigh pad
Avesh pounds it on a heavy length and outside off, messes with Moeen's on-the-up punch. The ball dribbles away to mid-off
back of a length and on the hips at 140ks, diverted to square leg
dug in short and outside off, this delivery doesn't come onto Raina. He delays the cut, and scythes it away in the air between backward point and cover-point for four
Woakes floats a full-toss outside off, Raina merely opens the bat-face and dinks it to extra-cover. No real urgency from CSK yet
short and outside off, not all that short, but Raina gets that exaggerated hop going - he often did this in 2019 - fending it off to the covers
Raina rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and guides it to point
mighty full on off, not quite a yorker, squirted back to the bower

edged and grabbed by Dhawan at slip. All-new season. Same-old powerplay problems for CSK. Test-match line and length from Woakes. Perfectly-pitched ball, full, angling in at off, so Gaikwad has to play at this. He has a firm-handed jab at it from the crease and the Woakes' outswing coaxes the outside edge. Dhawan takes a smart, low catch to his right
shorter and outside off, stabbed into the covers
darted full and outside off, driven through the line to mid-off

another inducker from Avesh, pins the front pad. Faf has been given out lbw. He has a chat with Gaikwad, and then walks off. Much fuller and skids back at 140ks, a crease-bound Faf searches for the drive, but is rushed for pace and ends up wearing it on his front pad in line with off. That looked pretty adjacent. Faf bags a duck in CSK's season-opener. The tracker returns umpire's call on middle - bail-trimmer
back of a length and on the hips, Avesh gets away with that. Fine leg was inside the circle, but Woakes tumbles to his left to stop this glance from Gaikwad
on a length and on off, 138ks, Gaikwad gets right behind the line and defends more solidly
inducker from a back of a length at 138ks, it looked a lot quicker to me. Skids back in to cramp the batsman for both length and room. Pinged on the midriff
good length and straying down the leg side, away from the reach of Gaikwad's glance, leg-side wide
shorter and holds its line outside off, lashed off the back foot straight to Hetmyer at extra-cover or rather square-point. The off-side infield is packed for both right-handers
another inswinger, finishes on the pads, Faf holds his shape and flicks it straight to midwicket
full inswinger, Gaikwad falls over the leg-side flick, diverted away square through the leg side
sweet as... A bit too full and outside off but not a half-volley. Gaikwad leans into it and caresses it, opening the face of the bat to pick the gap between backward point and cover-point
on a length and largely holds its line just a shade outside off, a crease-bound Gaikwad jabs it back to Woakes via an inside edge
beats the outside edge right away! Nice and full, threatens to angle in from over the wicket, but swings away past the bat as Gaikwad has a iffy waft at it in the channel
Pant finishes it off with a boundary, with Dhoni behind the stumps, on his IPL captaincy debut! Pitched up and outside off, right in Pant's swinging arc, muscled away to the long-on fence
Holes out to Curran at deep midwicket. Banged into the middle of the pitch, Stoinis can't get hold of the pull. He splices it to deep midwicket, where Curran lunges forward to snaffle it
knuckle-ball full-toss just outside off, dips late, surprises Stoinis. Played back to Thakur
full-toss shaping down the leg side, duly deflected fine of long leg for four
overpitched and outside off once again, this is drilled away to sweeper cover
overpitched and outside off, crunnnnnnnnnched through the covers with immense power
full-toss outside off, swished up to sweeper cover
yorker, bending in, squirted through midwicket
slower ball outside off, dinked through the covers
full and wide outside off, sliced fine of square third man
back of a length and outside off, punched through the line to extra-cover
lifter outside off, too high, wide called

short, wide, smeared away to the left of sweeper cover. Jadeja tears across to his left and hunts it down. Replays indicate Jadeja's foot was in contact with the ad board while trying to make the save
back of a length and snaking away like a quick legcutter. Stoinis is beaten outside off
yorker and tails in so very late to strike the pad bang in front of middle. Dhawan shuffled across off for the wider one, but Thakur finally gets his line and length right this time
full-toss, sprayed past the tramline, off-side wide
Dhawan knows Thakur will bowl wide of off. He shuffles across the stumps and sweeps it over backward square leg with great control
overpitched and wide outside off, shellacked through the covers. Thakur's night keeps getting worse
full-toss outside off, drilled ram-rod straight, so much so it demolishes the stumps at the other end
full-toss floated past the tramline, off-side wide
Dhawan shuffles across off again, shovelled from outside off to deep midwicket
quicker full ball outside off, Dhawan swishes and misses
Dhawan shuffles across off, Bravo misses his length. This full-toss outside off is swept away to the midwicket fence
slower ball outside off, flapped away towards short fine leg off the inner half
full-toss outside off, punched to extra-cover
short, wide, the lefties keep Moeen busy at sweeper. This is slashed more or less straight to him
Dhawan jumps across off even before Chahar delivers. This full-toss is punched down to long-on
hip-high short ball outside off, Pant goes deep in the crease, and hauls it away to deep midwicket
short, wide again, this time to Pant. Crunnnnnnched away to the right of Moeen at sweeper
short and wide of off, carved away to sweeper cover
on a length and outside off, Dhawan, having, shuffled across off, picks it up and dispatches it behind square with a sweep. Just bounces in front of the boundary
yorker outside off, jabbed back to Bravo
back of a length and sliding into the thigh pad, Pant can't quite flick it away
another slower ball wide of off, 114ks, chipped into the covers

After having seen two catches dropped off his bowling, Moeen hangs onto one at sweeper cover. Full and wide, Bravo rolls out another cutter. Shaw tries to reach out for it, he loses his balance in the process and drops down to his knee, carving a catch to the outfielder. End of a sensational innings that has all but sealed the chase for DC
Dhawan ventures down the track, meets a full ball outside off early and scythes it to the left of Chahar at sweeper cover
slower ball outside off, 100.1ks, edged behind to Dhoni. Shaw and Dhawan scamper across even as Dhoni runs in and under-arms it onto the stumps. Dhawan is just in
clipped through midwicket
scooped over mid-off. 98ks dart outside off, pretty full, Shaw gets under it and slices it over the top
clears Rayudu at deep square leg. Flat and quick on middle, Shaw heaves it away over the fielder on the leg side
Dhawan steps away outside leg, chops from the stumps to the off-side sweeper
on a length and spins in at off, forced down to long-on
speared outside off, flayed down to Jadeja at long-off
Dhawan shows his ace early, dashes out of the crease. Moeen sends a beamer outside off. Dhoni gathers it and flips the bails off, but by then Dhawan is back in

full and wide outside off, 132ks, Dhawan reaches out for the ball and drills it straight into Bravo's shin. Replays indicate Bravo tried to stop the ball with his right hand, but it popped out and he also tumbled in his followthrough
slower ball floated on middle, punched to the right of long-on, where Faf hunts it down
wide full-toss, 130ks, belted straight to extra-cover
wide yorker, Dhawan shuffles across off again, stabbed down to long-on
slower ball wide of off. Dhawan jumps across off, and shovel-pulls it over square leg, no protection in the deep
slower ball outside off, 96ks, check-driven up to sweeper cover
overpitched and outside off, Dhawan backs away, creates more swinging room and laces this slower ball through the covers.
short, wide, cracked away to the right of Moeen at sweeper cover
shorter and angling into middle and leg, knocked through midwicket
back of a length and attached with width outside off, belted through the covers. CSK are running out of ideas. The senior men Dhoni and DJ Bravo get together for a chat

chest-high short ball on middle, Dhawan rolls his wrists and controls a pull towards deep square leg. Dhawan gets to a fifty of his own, off 35 balls. A hand shake from Shaw is part of the celebrations
dug in short and outside off, Dhawan shovel-pulls it away between deep midwicket and deep square leg
long-hop on off stump, Shaw lines it up and smashes a pull to the right of midwicket to open his IPL 2021 season with a 27-ball half-century
tapped down to long-on
speared into the pads, Dhawan can't put it away
Another drop off Moeen, this is a tougher chance. Gaikwad runs in from deep midwicket, slides on his knees, but can't catch this. Dragged down on off, Shaw pulls in the air and gets away once again
swept flat and hard from a middle-stump line to deep square leg
pushed through into middle and leg from round the wicket, Dhawan dashes out of his crease and smears it over the midwicket boundary with the angle
103.3ks dart wide of off, just inside the tramline, left alone
down the track and lofted over the long-on boundary. Darted into the swinging arc, pumped over the top once again
round-arm dart outside off, inside-edged towards square leg
"caaatch it Bravo" is the cry, but this is scooped well in front of him at wide long-off
darted on middle, sliding into a back-foot punch to long-off
shorter and outside off, slashed to sweeper cover
knocked through midwicket
down the track, takes a full-toss, and secures a single down to long-off
swept away to deep square leg, good save from Jadeja
Dhawan aims leg side, chips a leading edge to the off side

Two men converge, but this is dropped by Santner in the end. Floated up on a length and outside off, Shaw skies it. DJ Bravo runs back from extra-cover, Santner comes in from wide long-off. There's miscommunication between the two. Santner belatedly dives, gets his hands to the ball, but shells it

dangled up on leg stump from round the wicket, Dhawan ventures a reverse-sweep, but the ball dips and hits the pad. Dhoni collects the ball, but can't throw the stumps down. Dhawan gets Shaw back on strike
109ks short dart, which is hauled away to deep midwicket
arm ball from Jadeja, snakes it on a back of a length, turned away throgh backward square leg
dragged from outside off to deep square leg with a flat, hard sweep. Santner cleans up in the deep once again
shortish and sliding across off, Dhawan leans back and chops it to point
tossed up on a length and spins away outside off, sliced in the air, but doesn't carry to long-off
dragged down on middle, hauled away to deep square leg, where Santner, the sub, gathers the ball
hip-high short ball outside off at 118ks, Dhawan swats it away through the leg side. Moeen throws himself to his right at midwicket and stops it
slower ball, full at 118ks, from round the wicket. Dhawan drives early at this knuckle ball and ekes out an inside edge onto the pad
knuckle ball on a back of a length, Shaw waits for the ball to arrive, then directs it to short third man
dug in shorter and outside off, Shaw rides the bounce and pats it to point
back of a length and outside off, Shaw gets closer to the pitch, and doesn't go stabbing at this. He opens the bat-face and eases it between point and short third man again
Chahar floats a wide full-toss, slashed to sweeper cover
wow, this is even better from Shaw. Pumped over mid-off. Thakur explores the full length again. Shaw gets underneath the length, shows off the full face of the bat, and hits over the top
shorter and outside off, 137ks, Shaw uses the pace of Thakur to his advantage and deftly glides it between short third man and backward point
regal drive from Shaw. This is not a half-volley around off, he presses forward and punches it on the up to ping the cover fence once again
back of a length and outside off, weakly driven to mid-off off the inside half
Thakur goes for the wide yorker, Dhawan, having shuffled across off, opens the face and squeezes it away between short third man and backward point for another four
Thakur hits a heavy length and cramps Dhawan for room and length. Played back to him
shellacked through the covers. Curran pitches it up, searching for swing, but this white ball is travelling in straight lines. Shaw latches onto the width and creams it away
slower offcutter, clipped through midwicket
top shot from Dhawan. He launches Curran into the DC dug-out. Pitched up and outside off, right in Dhawan's swinging arc. He extends his hands and hoists it over the bowler's head
Curran takes pace off this but strays into the pads of Dhawan, with fine leg inside the circle. This offcutter is glanced away past the right of a tumbling DJ Bravo
full and on the pads, Shaw, having shuffled across off, picks it away to Rayudu at deep midwicket
on a length and outside off, Dhawan jabs it to Thakur at the edge of the ring at mid-off and scampers across for the single
full and outside off, looks like another slower ball, yes it is. 118ks, Dhawan opens the bat-face and drives it to off-side sweeper (Jadeja)
hip-high short ball on middle, slower variation from Chahar. Shaw delays the pull and swats it away. Jadeja runs across and hunts it down at deep midwicket
full and outside off, seam-up, check-driven through the line to mid-off
good response from Chahar. Knuckle ball, nips away past the outside edge as Shaw spars at it outside off
clears mid-on and clears the boundary! Back of a length and angling into the body of Shaw, he is on the front foot as he pumps a pull over the infielder
full and outside off, Shaw gets forward and closer to the pitch before driving it to short cover
another length-ball cutter, 109ks, stops on Shaw. He checks his drive and pushes it in front of cover
kicks up from a back of a length and doesn't come onto Dhawan. It's the cutter. Spliced through the covers
punchily driven straight of mid-off. Slightly overpitched and outside off, Dhawan flows forward and laces it through the line
a bit too full and outside off, Dhawan drives firmly, but Gaikwad makes a sprawling save to his left from short cover
Sam hits that in-between length and hugs the off-stump line. Dhawan camps back and fends it off
pitched up and angling away outside off, Shaw presses forward, gets closer to the pitch and drives through the covers
full and slanting into the pads, whisked away to midwicket
shorter and bending away outside off, Dhawan glides it to point
full and wide outside off, Dhawan latches onto this wide half-volley and thrashes it away behind point for four
on a length and bending away outside off, Shaw aims to drive on the up and ends up carving an outside edge to deep third man
back of a length and finishing on the hips, right in Shaw's flicking radar. Dispatched to the square boundary on the leg side
nice and full, swinging into middle, driven to mid-on off the front foot
